reserve_usage: Settings startup/restoration each charged30 at submission;435 remaining ticks are failure/cleanup reserve only, never extra measurement, retry, or run. Fault/terminal observation remains120ticks/10s.
io_executor: single separate process; one owner-requested operation in flight; batch_sync false; no autonomous ticks
supervision: separate process with phase/task/owner/RPC deadlines; no ticks; no lock held over RPC
deadline_policy: One absolute monotonic deadline per operation, shared by owner/IO/watchdog; min(operation,phase,whole-run,original-observation where applicable). No reset on receive/heartbeat/late response.
initialization_policy: 30s total including setup/readiness/settling, at most60 attempted ticks; last21 consecutive confirmed speed norms<=0.1m/s; owner waits before submission until previous actual RPC start+0.05s. No catch-up.
transport: Immutable per-target BGRA files and checked observation JSON; publish request only after collection+archive complete; one task; no shared memory
validation_start: Forward+decode completion; same absolute deadline across worker and owner
pid_budget_note: Prior real PID synthetic preflight evidence reused without a new call; all24 new PID calls reserved for24 live targets. Validate budget before model load. Old ledger remains unchanged.
parked_handoff_scope: Only confirmed parked/frozen, completeSTOP feedback, no pending or unresolved operation, same run/episode/actor/epoch, unlocked. PlannedHoldBrake and post-completion parked restoration only; initial/fault/moving deadlines unchanged.
parked_handoff_basis: Explicit design allowance for already confirmed braking, not measured server response bound or repaired RPC root cause. No timeout retry or extension.
